Method of Attack: Injecting malicious JavaScript-based card skimming scripts into checkout pages of e-commerce sites
Hosting skimming scripts on cloud platforms like Heroku, GitHub, Amazon CloudFront, and misconfigured Amazon S3 buckets
Using modular card skimming web apps with malicious iframes to collect credit card information without user knowledge
Exfiltrating stolen payment card data to storage on Heroku
Impacted Systems: E-commerce sites including Magento-powered, OpenCart, PrismWeb, OSCommerce-powered stores
Attack Vector: Injection of malicious JavaScript skimmers into compromised e-commerce checkout pages
Abuse of cloud hosting services (Heroku freemium accounts, GitHub repositories, Amazon CloudFront and S3 buckets)
Indicators of Compromise: Base64 encoded string Y2hlY2tvdXQ= (checkout) in URLs triggering malicious iframe injection
Skimmer overlay iframe on payment forms
Misconfigured Amazon S3 buckets hosting skimming code
Obfuscated card skimming scripts hosted on GitHub
Skimmers injected on NBA.com Washington Wizards page
